description: The course aims to equip the learner with an understanding of human resource management activities as a function.
longDescription: Effective human resource strategy requirements. Smart Objectives. Monitoring effective human resource management. Human resource management contributions. Evaluating performance of human resource management. Quantitative and Qualitative measurement. Costs and benefits utility analysis. Improving Human Resource Management Strategies. The course aims to equip the learner with an understanding of human resource management activities as a function.
